meta.name: Osmosis 720p
meta.description:
In Paris of the near future, a dating app matches singles with their soul mates by mining their brain data. But decoding true love comes at a price.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: The Test
videos.overview: Just as siblings Esther and Paul Vanhove recruit a group of young people to test their revolutionary soul mate implant, investors drop a bombshell.

videos.title: Soulmate
videos.overview: While the testers venture out into the world to meet their soul mates, Paul agonizes over Joséphine, and Esther takes a drastic step to help her mom.

videos.title: Troubles
videos.overview: After stumbling on a clue to Joséphine’s fate, Esther worries there’s a mole at the company. Billie asks Niels to take a break from seeing Claire.

videos.title: Crisis
videos.overview: Esther tries to help Paul connect with Joséphine in virtual space. Niels learns his status in the test is in jeopardy. Ana rethinks her mission.

videos.title: Betrayal
videos.overview: Paul learns the truth about Joséphine’s disappearance, Niels seeks help at a residential clinic, and the testers’ hallucinations take a dark turn.

videos.title: Separation
videos.overview: To activate her mother’s memory, Esther returns to their old home and uncovers a shocking family secret. Niels receives an unexpected visitor.

videos.title: Redemption
videos.overview: As both Esther and Lucas struggle to come to terms with their new realities, Billie helps Ana through a crisis, and Martin begins to act erratically.

videos.title: Rebirth
videos.overview: With the testers’ lives hanging in the balance, Esther goes to extremes to revive Martin. Meanwhile, Paul and the company prepare for launch day.
